summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-10 filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, reporting that Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator, furnished a preliminary remarketing memorandum to remarketing agents for qualified institutional buyers regarding the Trust's Class A-7A, A-7B, and A-8 Reset Rate Notes. The memo includes pool information as of August 31, 2026, attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine securitization remarketing disclosure, not a special situation. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is stated. Watch for post-remarketing note pricing, but no risk-arb angle.
